```{r}
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r}
library(fda)
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("dis_data.csv")
```

```{r}
t <- 1:nrow(df)
districts <- c("Barguna", "Netrokona", "Joypurhat", "Mymensingh")
```

```{r}
nbasis <- 21
basis <- create.fourier.basis(rangeval = c(1,120), nbasis = nbasis)
```

```{r}
imputed_data <- df

for (d in districts) {
  
  y <- df[[d]]
  
  # remove NA for fitting
  observed_idx <- which(!is.na(y))
  
  t_obs <- t[observed_idx]
  y_obs <- y[observed_idx]
  
  # smooth using only observed points
  fd_fit <- smooth.basis(argvals = t_obs,
                         y = y_obs,
                         fdParobj = basis)$fd
  
  # predict for all time points
  y_fitted <- eval.fd(t, fd_fit)
  
  # replace only missing values
  missing_idx <- which(is.na(y))
  imputed_data[[d]][missing_idx] <- y_fitted[missing_idx]
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
districts <- c("Barguna", "Netrokona", "Joypurhat", "Mymensingh")
```

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Build tidy long-format data with observation type labels
## ----------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
build_plot_df <- function(district) {
  obs_vals  <- df[[district]]
  imp_vals  <- imputed_data[[district]]

  data.frame(
    t        = t,
    Observed = obs_vals,
    Imputed  = imp_vals,
    Year     = rep(2015:2024, each = 12)[t],
    Type     = ifelse(is.na(obs_vals), "Imputed", "Observed")
  )
}
```

```{r}
plot_list <- lapply(districts, function(d) {
  df_plot <- build_plot_df(d)

  # Year axis ticks
  year_ticks  <- seq(1, 120, by = 12)
  year_labels <- 2015:2024

  # Separate data for points
  obs_pts <- df_plot %>% filter(Type == "Observed")
  imp_pts <- df_plot %>% filter(Type == "Imputed")

  ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = t)) +
    # Fitted curve (blue, full series)
    geom_line(aes(y = Imputed), color = "#1B6CA8", linewidth = 0.9,
              linetype = "solid") +
    # Observed points (dark grey filled circles)
    geom_point(data = obs_pts, aes(y = Observed, shape = "Observed"),
               color = "grey30", size = 1.8, alpha = 0.85) +
    # Imputed points (red triangles, larger for visibility)
    geom_point(data = imp_pts, aes(y = Imputed, shape = "Imputed"),
               color = "#C0392B", size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Observed" = 16, "Imputed" = 17),
      name   = NULL
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_ticks, labels = year_labels) +
    labs(
      title = d,
      x     = "Year",
      y     = "Water Table Depth (m)"
    ) +
    annotate("text",
             x = max(imp_pts$t, na.rm = TRUE),
             y = Inf,
             label = paste0(nrow(imp_pts), " month(s) imputed"),
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
             size = 3, color = "#C0392B") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )
})
```

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 2x2 combined panel
## ----------------------------------------------------------

```{r,fig.height=10,fig.width=10}
(plot_list[[1]] | plot_list[[2]]) /
  (plot_list[[3]] | plot_list[[4]]) +
  plot_annotation(
    title   = "FDA-Based Imputation of Missing Monthly Water Table Values",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Blue line: Fourier-smoothed fit  |  ",
      "\u25CF Grey circles: observed  |  ",
      "\u25B2 Red triangles: imputed values"
    ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30")
    )
  )
```

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Tabulate where (which months/years) imputation occurred
## ----------------------------------------------------------

```{r}
cat("=== Imputed Months by District ===\n")
for (d in districts) {
  missing_idx <- which(is.na(df[[d]]))
  years_miss  <- ((missing_idx - 1) %/% 12) + 2015
  months_miss <- ((missing_idx - 1) %% 12) + 1
  cat(sprintf("\n%s (%d missing):\n", d, length(missing_idx)))
  print(data.frame(Index = missing_idx,
                   Year  = years_miss,
                   Month = month.abb[months_miss]))
}
```
